corrections.old_text: ኀበ ፡ ሃይማኖት ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ኪያሁ ፡ በአንሥኦቱ ፡
corrections.corrected_text: ኀበ ፡ ሃይማኖት ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ኪያሁ ፡ በአንሥኦ ፡
corrections.reason: The printed text at the end of Col 2 L02 is 'በአንሥኦ ፡' without '-ቱ', which is also directly confirmed when the Andemta commentary quotes this exact phrase in L09 ('ኪያሁ ፡ በአንሥኦ ፡ እሙታን ፡ ያለውን ፡').
The final character of 'ከምኵራቡ' clearly has the 2nd-order vowel mark (ካዕብ 'ቡ' with the horizontal stroke on the right leg), meaning 'into the synagogue'.
